metadata.description: Generate 3D models from multiple view images using Hi3D V3.0.

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

Hitem3dV30MultiViewTo3dInput.description: Input for Hi3D v3.0 multi-view generation.

back_image_url.description: URL of the back view image (PNG/JPEG/WebP, up to 20MB).
back_image_url.title: Back Image Url

enable_pbr.description: Generate PBR material maps together with the texture. Only supported (and billed) for v2.0/v2.1 and v3.0 models when enable_texture is true; ignored otherwise.
enable_pbr.title: Enable Pbr

enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, input images are checked for safety before processing.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

enable_texture.description: Whether to generate textures in addition to geometry. When false, only the geometry mesh is generated (and billed).
enable_texture.title: Enable Texture

export_format.description: File format of the generated model.
export_format.title: Export Format

face_count.description: Target face count. The partner recommends 2,000,000 for 2048quality and 5,000,000 for 2048master.
face_count.title: Face Count

front_image_url.description: URL of the front view image (PNG/JPEG/WebP, up to 20MB).
front_image_url.title: Front Image Url

left_image_url.description: URL of the left view image (PNG/JPEG/WebP, up to 20MB).
left_image_url.title: Left Image Url

model.description: Hi3D v3.0 model version used by this endpoint.
model.title: Model

resolution.description: Generation resolution. 2048quality is the faster default; 2048master provides the highest quality.
resolution.title: Resolution

right_image_url.description: URL of the right view image (PNG/JPEG/WebP, up to 20MB).
right_image_url.title: Right Image Url

Hitem3dV30MultiViewTo3dInput.title: V3MultiViewTo3DInput

Hitem3dV30MultiViewTo3dOutput.description: Output of the 3D model generation endpoints.

thumbnail.description: Preview image of the generated model, when available.

Hitem3dV30MultiViewTo3dOutput.title: Hitem3DOutput

info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/hitem3d/v3.0/multi-view-to-3d queue.
info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/hitem3d/v3.0/multi-view-to-3d

x-fal-metadata.about: Generate a Hi3D v3.0 model from up to four view images.

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).
